_readme: Optional overrides for the event schedule that /timer board shows.
Copy this file to data/schedules.json (next to timers.db) and edit it there.
An entry with an existing id patches that event; a new id adds one;
"remove": true takes an event off the board.
For a single region the short "schedule" key is easiest - it always follows the
region the bot is set up for (SCHEDULE_REGION, default global-as). Use the
"schedules": { "<region>": ... } form only when you need to name a region.
The times below are EXAMPLES. Check them against your own server: the upstream
schedule is community data, and NCSOFT never published the Global event times.

events._comment: Patch an event that comes from the fetched schedule.
The resets are one instant worldwide, so they name their own timezone.
Add an event the public schedule does not know about.
